headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Chase Burns pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball. The Pittsburgh Pirates also secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Abner Uribe, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation, while Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. Other notable injuries include Matt Chapman's abdominal strain and Trevor McDonald's right elbow strain.

The Baltimore Orioles have made a trade, acquiring center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals have also made a trade, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with Seiya Suzuki leading the Cubs' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Matthew Liberatore pitched 5.1 innings for the Cardinals, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins, with Chase Burns pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 8 batters and allowing 4 hits. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Mason Montgomery earned the save.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox on August 12, 2026, as part of a trade. The deal also included a player to be named later from the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
